claim: The 2026 plantation-worker package set a Rs 1,550 daily basic wage plus a Rs 200 attendance allowance, alongside a Rs 5,000 million public allocation.

metric.value: Rs 1,550 basic + Rs 200 attendance allowance; Rs 5,000m allocation
metric.denominator: daily wage package for covered plantation workers and budget allocation for allowance mechanism
metric.basis: Cabinet decision and parliamentary committee record
metric.source_definition: nominal daily package and public allocation; not effective monthly earnings

bounded_by: Coverage, attendance realization and effective take-home pay are separate questions.
